name: Claims API
description: Lets other internal systems read and update claim data.

name: Claims Workbench
description: The app that claims adjusters use to review, assess, and pay claims.

name: Claims Intake
description: Receives new claims from the Customer Portal, the phone line, and brokers, and opens the claim file.

name: Policy API
description: Lets other internal systems read policy and coverage data.

name: Policy Database
description: The main database of policies, coverages, and policy changes.

name: Policy Admin
description: The app that staff use to issue, change, renew, and cancel policies.

name: Legacy Policy System
description: The old policy system. It is read-only and being retired, and it still holds the policies issued before 2019.

name: Pricing Engine
description: Calculates the price (the premium) of a quote or a renewal from rating tables, such as the prices by region.

name: Underwriting Rules
description: The automatic rules that accept or decline a new policy request, or send it to a person for review.

name: Customer Portal
description: The website where customers see their policies, pay, and report a claim, in French and English.

name: Broker Portal
description: The website where insurance brokers get quotes and manage their clients' policies.

name: Fraud Scoring Model
description: A model that gives each new claim a fraud-risk score.

name: Data Warehouse
description: The central store of policy and claims data used for reports and analysis.

name: Cloud Platform
description: The company's cloud environment: accounts, networks, and servers.

name: Deployment Pipeline
description: Builds, tests, and releases the code of every team.

name: Single Sign-On
description: The employee login for internal tools, with multi-factor authentication.
